parsed.use_case: A mapping service can count separate land regions in a satellite-derived mask to estimate distinct landmasses or connected flooded areas. The same task appears when grouping adjacent active cells in a grid-based simulation.
system_examples: Geospatial raster analysis systems — count contiguous land or flooded regions in classified satellite imagery.
Grid-based simulation software — count connected clusters of active cells in a cellular automaton or occupancy map.
parsed.explanation: A traversal marks each land cell as visited and explores its horizontal and vertical neighbors, taking O(rows × columns) time and O(rows × columns) worst-case space. This avoids repeatedly comparing every pair of cells and is practical because the work grows linearly with the input grid; the problem also serves mainly as a standard connected-component exercise.
